title: Barbers urges probe into alleged detention of Sara Duterte aides
summary: House prosecution panel adviser Ace Barbers has called on authorities to investigate allegations that two household helpers of Vice President Sara Duterte were detained and forced to sign a document…

blocks.text: House prosecution panel adviser Ace Barbers has called on authorities to investigate allegations that two household helpers of Vice President Sara Duterte were detained and forced to sign a document against their will.
Barbers made the call after Duterte’s spokesperson, Paolo Panelo, said the two household helpers were already safe and sound with assistance from the Office of the Vice President (OVP).

“This should be validated because this kind of incident should not happen. Dapat kasuhan natin kung sino man yung mga gumagawa niyan, dahil isa ‘yang krimen. Hindi dapat pinalalampas ‘yan,” Barbers said at a press conference.
“They should report it to the PNP or the NBI,” he added, referring to the Philippine National Police and the National Bureau of Investigation.
Barbers urged the complainants to seek government protection once they file a complaint, calling on law enforcement agencies to investigate and hold those responsible accountable.
“Once they are able to file the complaint, we urge the national government and all its agencies, law enforcement agencies to protect the complainants and go after the perpetrators,” he said.
House prosecutor Joel Chua of Manila also urged the two household helpers to file a complaint so those responsible could be held accountable.— MCG, GMA News
